test_title: SSC CGL 2024 Tier-I Official Paper (Held On: 12 Sept, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Six words Eat, Cry, Play, Sleep, Run and Bath are written on different faces of a dice. Three positions of this dice are shown in the figure. Find the word on the face opposite to Eat.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2968fdff3cdded05a1851d9fa3171d79ee1019d39c657976571049e3581814d3.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is :-

From the given three different dices the adjacent sides are as shown below :

As Play is common on both the dices I and III, it is clear that Eat, Cry, Run, and Sleep are adjacent to it, and the remaining i.e. Bath will be opposite to it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9887405371128f0244735d1656c911a3acce7731dd7738989e655de368e76e91.png] 

Opposite pairs:

Cry → Sleep

Eat → Run

Play → Bath

So, the opposite side of "Eat" will be side "Run".

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 4".
